title: Maapillai Seenu
desc: Seenu's debt-driven escape to Dubai accidentally reroutes him to Hyderabad. Upon arrival, a shocking discovery leads him to orchestrate a cunning plan.

title: Oh Baby
desc: A seventy-year-old woman frustrated with her life, blames God for her misfortune. Subsequently, she magically transforms into a twenty-four-year-old after getting her photo taken at a studio.

title: Ithu Enga Area
desc: Hari and Karthika fall in love with each other but are distraught when they find they are from different castes. However, they decide to fight for their relationship and parents' approval.

title: Pulimurugan
desc: A small village seeks help from a man with extraordinary force to protect them against man-eating tigers and the drug mafia.

title: Pathaan
desc: A Pakistani general hires a private terror outfit to conduct attacks in India while Pathaan, an Indian secret agent, is on a mission to form a special unit.

title: Run Run Run
desc: An unemployed computer engineer finds himself indebted to a ruthless money lender. However, things take a turn when he is robbed on his way to pay off his debts.

title: Poraali
desc: Kumaran and Nallavan relocate to Chennai to start a new life. Though they get employed and are successful in the beginning, eventually their past comes to haunt them.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A compilation of catchy and entertaining popular songs composed by famed artists and musicians from varied Tamil movies.

title: Iruvarin Ulagam Ondre
desc: A man and a woman, who are born on the same day, fall in love with each other. However, due to unfortunate circumstances, they keep getting separated.

title: Kanne Kalaimaane
desc: Kamalakannan, an organic farmer, marries Bharathi, a bank manager. However, his grandmother does not want his wife to work after marriage, which leads to a tussle between them.
